shared_original_behavior_function:
f_behavior(float baseline) =>
    int code = 0
    if baseline > 0 and not na(close[13])
        float base = close[13]
        float bottom = 0.0
        float top = 0.0
        int bottomAt = 0
        int topAt = 0
        bool contiguous = true
        for i = 12 to 1
            contiguous := contiguous and time[i] == time - i * 300000
            float value = (close[i] - base) / baseline
            if value < bottom
                bottom := value
                bottomAt := 13 - i
            if value > top
                top := value
                topAt := 13 - i
        float finish = (close[1] - base) / baseline
        bool recovery = bottom <= -0.08 and finish - bottom >= 0.08 and bottomAt < 12
        bool fade = top >= 0.08 and top - finish >= 0.08 and topAt < 12
        code := not contiguous ? 0 : recovery and fade ? (bottomAt < topAt ? 4 : 3) : recovery ? 3 : fade ? 4 : finish >= 0.05 ? 1 : finish <= -0.05 ? 2 : 5
    code
